title: Super Princess Peach - Freezie and Flameface
description:
These sprites both appear in Super Princess Peach from Worlds 4 and 6, Fury Volcano and Gleam Glacier. They act as decorations but they can also be used as hazards too good for any ice and fire-themed levels.

Rykon-V73 Edit: Flameface animation uses half of it's original animation due to repeating tiles.
